top_violation_types.title: An administrative penalty not assessed against your center during previous two years while your director was serving in that role (26 TAC §746.1317(a)(6)(C))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a review of the staff trainings there were trainings certificates with the director's name on it. The director was listed as the trainer.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Report of Criminal Complaint Against Employees (26 TAC §746.305(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegations and found to be deficient. The operation did not report a caregiver who was arrested to licensing in the appropriate time frame.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection a caregiver was observed to be alone with a group of children when the conditions of their background check stated that they cannot be alone with a child or group of children.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan-  Screen Time Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection,  the schoolers classroom was observed with Netflix on that was not educational and did not correspond to the daily activities.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.
